# codex-rg13-20261007-quote-checker

A server to check if a synthetic quote is valid based on a given amount.

## Installation

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

## Usage

```bash
npm start
```

## Tools

### `check_synthetic_quote`

Checks if a synthetic quote is valid based on the provided amount.

docker build -t codex-rg13-20261007-quote-checker .
